title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Bar Chart – Household Internet Access by Region
prompt: The bar chart below shows the percentage of households with internet access in four regions (Northland, Southland, Eastland, and Westland) in the years 2005, 2010, and 2015. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请根据柱状图描述四个地区在三个年份的家庭互联网接入率变化，并比较地区差异。写作时注意：1. 开头段改写题目；2. 概述段总结主要趋势（如整体上升、地区间差距变化）；3. 主体段用具体数据支持比较；4. 不要加入个人观点或原因分析；5. 字数不少于150词。
